what: a flint hoe: one flat blade like a garden hoe, about 10 px wide and 4-5 px tall, set at a right angle across the top of the handle and pointing down-left, made of crude knapped grey-brown flint with chipped faceted edges and a few lighter flake scars, lashed with tan sinew cord to a plain wooden handle; never a hammer head nor a thin hook, lying diagonally, handle at the bottom left, tip at the top right, filling the canvas corner to corner
